detail.longDescription: Hi does anyone know what the correct way to implement something like this is? It seems like some gpus can't interrupt the long running onnx operations in order to prepare frame for rendering. Which leads to application having low frame rate. Is there a way to tell if a GPU will handle context switching between ML and graphics or is the only option to optimise the underlying model ops to run faster, I'm specifically referring to windows across different gpus intel, nvidia etc, thanks
